title: Bob Thomas, trombonist
summary: Vincent comes up with Robert Thomas, a trombonist now sick.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Ask him if he worked with Bob Thomas ever, Robert Thomas.
You work with Bob Thomas in it? Who? Bob Thomas. Robert Thomas. Palmer? Oh, Palmer. No, Thomas. Thomas Thomas. Robert Thomas.

Robert Thomas. Robert Thomas. Robert Thomas. Thomas Thomas. You don't mean Kit Thomas, huh? Robert Thomas. Play trombone. Oh. They call him Bob. Yeah. Ooh, they'll be Bob come up together. Yeah, he's a place to play with us. Bob, I don't know if he's playing yet. He's sick. No. He's sick. Yeah. Sick. He's sick. Oh, yeah. He's been sick a good while. He ain't got up there about twice with pennies, you know. And then he left and went to Baton Rouge. Yeah, we used to call him Bob. Bob Thomas, you know. Yeah, we come up together, me and him. See, sometimes we called him a fella by the name. You don't know. I come in and nick me and I can say, you know Climb's with? I say, who the hell is Climb's with? He said, you don't know Danny? He said, well, I don't know Danny. You don't know Charlie? Yeah, that's the way they go, you see.
